question: What is said about the eight-lettered and nine-lettered forms?
premises: The eight-lettered form is called great fierce yoga lord.
The nine-lettered form is more secret true being time-drawing.
inference: Therefore the verse distinguishes an eight-lettered and a more secret nine-lettered form.
plain_english: The eight-lettered form is called great fierce yoga lord, while the nine-lettered form is the more secret true being, time-drawing.
